statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the least integer k with k >= 1 for which there exist indices 0 = p0 < p1 < ... < pk = len(s) such that, for every j with 1 <= j <= k, the segment s[p_{j-1}..p_j) is balanced. A segment s[l..u) with 0 <= l < u <= len(s) is balanced iff, for every byte c, letting cnt(c) = #{i | l <= i < u and s[i] = c}, the set of positive values cnt(c) over all bytes c has exactly one element; equivalently, whenever cnt(c) > 0 and cnt(d) > 0, cnt(c) = cnt(d).
preconditions: 1 <= len(s) <= 1000 and every byte s[i] with 0 <= i < len(s) is the ASCII code of a lowercase English letter ('a' through 'z').
